comment: GREAT GREAT GREAT Professor. So knowledgeable and passionate. There can be a lot of homework, but not unbearable. The tests are very very easy. All directions for essays are straightforward. AMAZING class!

Dr Holloway is a brilliant and engaging professor. She does a great job moderating discussions wherein viewpoints from across the political spectrum are welcomed and engaged with in a professional manner. I, personally, disagreed with many political takes from readings yet always felt respected and eager to contribute to discussions.

She is funny, chill, and wants you to do well, especially if you show her you are putting in effort/participating. You will have one or two readings before every class which as long as you do them and have a general understanding, you are good. In class, it's just discussions on the reading, then you have 2 papers, 2 tests (easy), and 1 final.
LOVE DR. HOLLOWAY!!!!! She is literally the best prof at UR shes so fun -- class makeup is 3 tests and 3 papers

super passionate and lovely professor. her tests are pretty straightforward if you do the readings and engage consistently with lectures, and the papers are not too bad and actually pretty interesting! loved this class felt like i learned a lot. dr. holloway is amazing and cares a lot about what she teaches and for her students!!!

PIPPAPAAAAA. I love love love her. Everyone in the history class should be so blessed to take her. The GOAT. Do the readings (you don't even have to do all of them all the time—but you should!) and the class should be TOTALLY fine. You will gain a ton from her ANY of her classes.

Dr. Holloway is the example of what all professors should be. She makes personal connections with every student and is overall one of the most caring people I have ever met! I will spend the rest of my academic career looking for a professor as dedicated, knowledgeable, and compassionate as Dr. Holloway

Dr. Holloway is amazing. She was highly knowledgable about every subject we covered and always made the lectures super funny and interesting. She was also really good at making room for all perspectives students may have had. The readings could be a bit dense, but she didn't expect you to understand everything and always went over them in class.

VERY reading and homework-heavy but engaging discussions. The class is what you make of it, if you participate and pay attention you'll get a lot out of it. She can be a bit disorganized with deadlines and lectures sometimes can get a little too detail-focused and it distracts from the big picture. Tests and papers are basically the whole grade

Definitely take her for gen ed! Very interesting topics. Reading and discussion heavy, but you can get away with not reading a few things. Not participating will show up in your final grade. Tests and papers are what really matter.

Dr. Holloway is simply the best. Her lectures are interesting and collaborative and she is very realistic with expectations for readings/work outside of class. The articles and chapters she assigns are interesting and genuinely so relevant to class discussions. She cares a lot about her students and loves to joke around. 100% would take again.

Dr. Hollaway was super engaging even on topics that are difficult to discuss. The papers were not too difficult and the prompts were clear. If you put any effort in, you will do well in the class. There were readings before every class, but it was ok if you only skimmed or didn't fully understand. 100% recommend any courses taught by Dr. Holloway!

I took Dr. Holloway's Lawrence v. Texas course. I would highly recommend taking any course with her. There were readings for every class but it was manageable. Tests were online and too hard. There were 3 5 page papers in the class but they were not bad and Dr. Holloway always gave great feedback. I'd recommend for your FSHT. Loved this course!

She does not try to indoctrinate you into any specific belief. Very accessible and fast to email back when you need help. Good grader and provides feedback on drafts that will enable you to earn high grades.

Dr. Holloway is amazing. She was highly knowledgable about every subject we covered and always made the lectures super funny and interesting. She was also really good at making room for all perspectives students may have had. The readings could be a bit dense, but she didn't expect you to understand everything and always went over them in class.

Great teacher for a Gen ed history pick. Took her Lawrence v Texas class. + Tests were online and open notes so if you did the reading and take notes should be an easy B at least + Papers are not too hard and she gives really good feedback and is also a lenient grader. + Participate in class + Daily reading is managable.

Dr. Holloway is accessible outside of class and very understanding anytime you request an extension or anything of the sort. Class participation is big and the reading assignments are hefty but she fully expects you to skim and not read them entirely. She gives very easy online tests and short paper prompts. She is a pretty fair & easy grader.

very nice and a good teacher but the class is what you make out of it. It is mostly discussion based and based off the readings but it is a lot of reading (like 2-3 court cases and a supplemental reading) but you don't necessarily have to do it. Papers are fine just not the clearest expectations and prompts are either super vague or only specific

I took L v. Texas. lots of readings for homework. She goes over readings the next day and they're the class notes. PARTICIPATE for grade! She gives online tests where you have a week to complete. very few options for grades. I had three papers and 3 tests. She grades on class participation so if you don't read(like me), then ask questions.

Friendly and has firsthand experience with a number of the figures and topics she teaches on. Highly knowledgeable. A lot of reading is assigned. Aside from that, her class was very light for homework. Just the occasional essay or project.
